answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and complete a slow, verifiable proof-of-useful-work before earning attestation weight, so a sybil swarm must pay real compute and locked capital per identity. Like crystal growing under pressure, trust accrues slowly; a gale of cheap clones cannot shortcut it, and basalt-solid history, past attestations that can be slashed for fraud, makes each fake identity expensive to build and costly to burn.
